title: Audio-reactive track runner that generates a track from any song
author: cylindrical_basis
selftext:
I always liked audiosurf and other similar rhythm games, wanted something I could throw music at and see what the game did with it. Ended up becoming a bit more than just a track runner in the end, still working on some proper gameplay mechanics but it does give me that thought of "what would that song be like to play" (though maybe that's just too much testing of the analyzer. So so many passes).



Pretty happy in the end with how reliably it understands the music, across genres it keeps surprising me. Intense sections can become a bit ridiculous but tried to keep the clarity somewhat there.

 

Mostly opus 5.5 with some sonnet. Threejs and the analyser is just js code that runs local. 15+ passes with over 90 stops, lots of back and forth. In-game tuning helped loads, having sliders and variables i can change in game and then give back to claude saves so much time. Even got it to make a tool specifically just for viewing the spaceship thing from different angles as it had trouble picking it up from screenshots and getting something close to what I wanted.
